name: Medical Science Field Atlas
scope: A modern polyhierarchy of medical science fields and subdisciplines
description: The complete local field atlas. It treats anatomy, disease, method, biological scale, population, care setting, and translational stage as intersecting coordinates rather than forcing every field into one tree.

name: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH)
description: A Medical Science Field Atlas crosswalk grouped by the most relevant high-level MeSH tree. MeSH is broader than fields and also organizes anatomy, diseases, processes, techniques, and health care.

name: ACGME Specialties
steward: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education
description: Clinical fields in the Medical Science Field Atlas that map to an ACGME specialty umbrella. This lens describes accredited professional training, not the whole of medical research.

name: OECD Fields of R&D (FORD)
steward: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
description: The complete Medical Science Field Atlas grouped into FORD's five medical and health science divisions. This lens is useful for portfolios and reporting, but intentionally coarse.

name: NIH RCDC
scope: Funded research, condition, and disease categories
description: Research areas and disease domains in the Medical Science Field Atlas that align with the overlapping topic model used for NIH categorical spending. It is a portfolio lens, not a field hierarchy.

name: WHO-FIC: ICD, ICF & ICHI
scope: Diseases, functioning, disability, and health interventions
description: Medical Science Field Atlas entries connected to ICD, ICF, or ICHI. These systems classify the objects and activities of medicine rather than scientific fields themselves.
